models_evaluated: three AI image generators (names not reported in the abstract)

links.outcome: Demographic representation of AI-generated plastic surgery patient images versus real-world patient demographics
links.effect: Platforms overrepresented non-White and female patients in cleft lip images (P<0.001). Aesthetic surgery images depicted only female patients. Non-White patients and those over 50 were underrepresented (P<0.0001).
links.quote: Current depictions of plastic surgery patients by AI platforms can foster stereotypes on sex and ethnicity of patients seeking plastic surgery.

links.outcome: Subgroup representation differences in generated images by race, sex, and age versus real-world demographics
links.effect: Non-White patients were underrepresented in breast augmentation and breast reconstruction images (P<0.0001). Non-White patients and those over 50 were underrepresented in aesthetic surgery images (P<0.0001).
links.quote: Non-White patients were also underrepresented in images of breast augmentation and breast reconstruction (P < 0.0001).

screen.reason: Evaluates demographic bias and representation in synthetic images generated by text-to-image AI platforms for plastic surgery patient prompts, but does not test an organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
